item.title: Families of victims killed in Jordanian strike deny links to church attack

item.description: Officials from Iran, Pakistan, Turkiye and Saudi Arabia held talks in Tehran in an effort to stop further escalation.

item.description: British Iranian Mohmed Abdulkarim and British citizen Nouman Essghir have been charged under the National Security Act.

item.description: Israelis vote as Netanyahu faces Gadi Eisenkot amid divisions over the wars in Gaza and Iran and growing isolation.

item.title: Turnout so far highest in decades as Israelis vote in pivotal election
item.description: The elections - the first since the Hamas-led attacks on Israel and the wars which followed - are widely seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu.
